name: Ensoras – AI Customer Support & Helpdesk
author: Ensoras AI

sections.description:
Ensoras adds an AI-powered customer support helpdesk to your WordPress site. Build custom workflows, automate responses, manage support tickets, and provide instant help to your visitors — no coding required.

When WooCommerce is active, Ensoras can also automatically look up orders, track shipments, check product availability, and handle refund inquiries.

Features:

  • One-click installation of the Ensoras support widget
  • AI-powered chat with customizable workflows and actions
  • Ticket management and customer insights via the Ensoras dashboard
  • Display controls: show on all pages, or include/exclude specific pages
  • No coding required

WooCommerce Integration (Optional):

When WooCommerce is active, clicking “Connect WooCommerce” generates read-only API credentials and sends them to Ensoras. Ensoras can then:

  • Look up customers by email or name
  • Retrieve order details and tracking information
  • List recent orders for a customer
  • Search and retrieve product information
  • Check refund status for orders
  • Automatically pre-fill logged-in customer emails

External Services

This plugin relies on the Ensoras external service to provide AI-powered customer support functionality. All AI processing, ticket management, and workflow execution happen on the Ensoras platform.

Account registration

When creating an account through the plugin, your email address, name, and site URL are sent to Ensoras to create your support project.

Chat widget

The chat widget JavaScript is loaded from the Ensoras CDN (app.ensoras.com) on every page where the widget is displayed. Chat messages entered by visitors are sent to Ensoras for AI processing and ticket creation.

Email verification

During account setup, your email address and name are sent to Ensoras to send a verification code.

WooCommerce provisioning (optional)

If you connect WooCommerce, read-only API credentials and your store URL are sent to Ensoras so it can access order and product data on behalf of your support team.

Customer identification (optional)

When enabled, logged-in WooCommerce customer emails are passed to the widget so Ensoras can identify returning customers and look up their order history.

  • Ensoras Privacy Policy
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory, or install through the WordPress plugin screen.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. Go to the Ensoras menu in your WordPress admin to configure.
  4. Either create a free Ensoras account or enter your existing project slug and API key.
  5. (Optional) If WooCommerce is active, click “Connect WooCommerce” to enable order and product support.
sections.faq:
Do I need a paid Ensoras account?

No. You can create a free account that includes 30 support tickets per month.

Does this require WooCommerce?

No. The support widget works on any WordPress site. WooCommerce integration is optional and adds order/product lookup capabilities.

What data does the WooCommerce integration access?

The plugin generates read-only WooCommerce API credentials. Ensoras can look up customers, orders, products, and refunds but cannot modify any data.

Can I control which pages show the widget?

Yes. Under Display Settings you can show the widget on all pages, only on specific pages, or exclude specific pages.
